title: Separate macOS zombie-cleanup readiness from a two-second physical capture window
outcome: bounded_read_cleanup_native_zombie_only_group_finishes_successfully proves retained zombie-only cleanup and exact exit/output independently of a two-second process-start/exit race.
acceptance: The macOS test observes the intended exited-but-unreaped child phase deterministically before judging cleanup, retaining status23 and exact stdout/stderr checks.
The regression does not race setup and exit against fresh physical two-second windows; production read/cleanup budgets are unchanged, with no retry or ignore.
